snippet.title: Evil Lurks Below - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3286560/Evil_Lurks_Below/


On the fourth anniversary of the Gilman family’s disappearance, rumored to be the result of a brutal murder, paranormal detective Harry Walters arrives at their eerie, abandoned house after hearing reports of paranormal activity.

His mission: uncover the family’s fate and close the case once and for all.

But the truth lies buried, and the deeper Harry digs, the more dangerous it becomes.

Can you unravel the secrets behind the Gilman family’s disappearance, or will the mystery remain unsolved forever?

KEY FEATURES
-A short psychological horror experience from a first-person perspective that is truly terrifying to play.

-Delve into the residents' past memories as a paranormal detective to uncover the truth of what really happened.

-Solve puzzles to escape the horrors that follow your every step.

-Retro PSX-inspired visuals.

-Do whatever it takes to survive: fight, run, and hide!
